Primary & secondary cover — limited windows

Based on the current leave dates, primary/secondary cover is thin at these points:
  • 22 Sep – 6 Oct — Joe Oki is off for his full leave block while Nishan Bansal is on paternity (17 Sep – ~17 Nov, TBC). Joe's primary cover (Nishan) is unavailable throughout, so cover sits solely with Doug Gill (secondary), who is also covering Nishan's desk. Confirm Doug's bandwidth or add a third recruiter.
  • Mon 5 Oct — Holly Wilson is also off, thinning the wider pool further.
  • Late Dec (21–31) — Holly Wilson off across the festive period alongside UK bank holidays 25 & 28. Primary covers (Sophie Doyle) remain available, but overall team capacity is reduced — plan ahead.

Effective handover — best practice (TWO DAYS BEFORE LEAVE)

  • ✓Start the handover document 2 days before your PTO, plus book in a call with your primary cover and ideally secondary cover too, to ensure enough time is given to answer questions and explain what is needed for your desk.
  • ✓Ensure your cover is made fully aware of where every role stands — which roles need applications reviewed, and which need sourcing.
  • ✓Confirm with your cover their capacity and bandwidth; decide if a third recruiter is needed to cover certain roles or workloads.
  • ✓Send over role kick-off documents to your cover with the yellow tables and notes fully completed so it is clear.
  • ✓Make clear the likely offers and the admin that may be needed, based on how far along each role's hiring activity is.
  • ✓Intro end-stage candidates via email with the buddy and/or a third talent partner when needed.
  • ✓Ensure your PTO is clearly marked on your calendar, your Slack headline and your Gmail OOO — state the name of your cover in your Slack PTO subject line and Gmail OOO message. Copy your team coverage into any relevant calendar events. Ensure your cover has GH access rights to the roles.
